result.stdout:
Usage: appdeployhub-agent [command] [options]

Commands:
  run (default)             Starts the build agent loop
  configure [options]       Saves the connection settings
  update                    Forces an agent update check and upgrade
  autostart, service <action> Manages auto-start on macOS
  tray                      Opens the macOS menu bar icon

Global options (run):
  --no-color, --nc          Disables terminal colors
  --no-web                  Disables the local web server (port 9595)
  -p, --web-port <port>     Changes the web server port (default: 9595)

Configure options:
  -u, --url <url>           Forge Dashboard URL
  -t, --token <pat>         GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT)
  -i, --interval <sec>      Polling interval in seconds
  -k, --api-key <key>       Forge API key (sent as X-API-Key; required once the Forge enforces agent auth)
  -l, --login               Authorize this machine in the browser (device flow) and store its own key
  -d, --dir <directory>     Custom directory to download and generate builds
  --unity-editors-path <d>  Where Unity Hub installs Editors (external drive for Unity builds)

Autostart actions:
  install                   Installs the LaunchAgent and starts it immediately
  uninstall                 Removes the LaunchAgent
  status                    Shows the LaunchAgent status
  logs                      Shows the LaunchAgent logs
